description: Recycling Modernisation Fund Data Viewer is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW). An interactive dashboard created and updated by the Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW). It allows users to search Recycling Modernisation Fund (RMF) funded projects by jurisdiction and location, and filter projects by material type, facility type, completion status, and remoteness (urban or regional/remote). Coverage is Australia, 2020 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-10. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
